name: ddrm
source: Zhao et al., Denoising Diffusion Recommender Model, SIGIR 2024; github.com/Polaris-JZ/DDRM @ ad4034c (DDRM_LightGCN: main.py, utils.py, model.py, diffusion.py, train*.py)
grid_source: The authors' train.py files fix diff_lr 1e-3, alpha 0.1 (ML-1M) or 0.5 (Amazon-Book), 50 steps, sampling steps 1.25 x steps, DNN dims [200,1000 or 1100], noise scale 1e-2 on [1e-4, 1e-3] and comment out alternatives (steps 10 to 60, alpha 0.1 to 0.5, noise scale 1e-5 to 1e-3). 8-trial budget: diff_lr {1e-3, 1e-4} x alpha {0.1, 0.5} x steps {10, 50}; everything else at the authors' values; our choice. The pipeline's --lr and --reg are those of the pretrained LightGCN.
memory: Pretrains the kit's plain LightGCN once per training file (cached under runs/_ddrm_pretrain, about the cost of one Plain-BPR run), then trains two small conditional DNNs on frozen embeddings; evaluation runs sampling_steps reverse steps per user batch. Time to be measured on the canary
